title: Quality ops: signal scrub & promptset sensitivity brief
body:
Purpose:
This is a biweekly signal-scrub focused on onboarding evals and promptset sensitivity for newly onboarded models and prompt suites. The doc is intentionally tactical — quick ownerable actions, prioritized hot clusters, and short experiments to validate mitigations before we roll to canary.

Executive snapshot (TL;DR):
- Overall quality index for new model cohort (v2.3 variants) dropped ~6% vs baseline on core promptsets (median answer correctness + safety). Most impact concentrated in three prompt families: policy-extraction, instruction-following with long context, and multi-turn stateful QA.
- Top 5 failure clusters identified from automated evals + human review. Rough estimate: 72% of alerts map to these clusters.
- Immediate mitigations (next 48–72h): revert a rollout route for high-risk customers, flag two promptsets for guardrail augmentation, deploy KV-cache hotfix for sequence truncation.

Context and scope:
- Window: 2026-07-01 -> 2026-07-14.
- Models in scope: rwin-v2.3-base, rwin-v2.3-quant, rwin-v2.3-longseq.
- Data sources: onboarding eval pipeline (promptset-runner v0.9), production sampled traces (1% token-sample), nightly human eval spot checks.
- Acceptance criteria for onboarding: no class of failure > 1.5x baseline frequency AND no safety regression in top-10 safety tests.

Top failure clusters (samples + quick triage):
1) Context bleed and hallucinated references (cluster id: CB-07)
   - Symptoms: model invents citations or asserts facts from previous unrelated conversation turns; confidence tone is high.
   - Example prompt (policy-extraction set): "Summarize regulation X and provide the clause number for the reporting requirement."
   - Detection signal: high hallucination score + citation token patterns + long context mismatch.
   - Quick hypothesis: new attention kernel in v2.3-longseq degrades long-range grounding, particularly when prompt contains enumerated clauses.
   - Suggested short-term fix: add conservative citation rewriting rule in post-process; mark promptset as guarded. Owner: Priya. Priority: P0.

2) Instruction erosion on nested tasks (cluster id: IE-03)
   - Symptoms: fails to follow nested instructions ("do A, then B on A's output") for tasks with >3 steps.
   - Example: multi-step transformation prompt in onboarding promptset-collector.
   - Hypothesis: beam/decoding config and temperature interaction with quantized kernels.
   - Mitigation: pin decoding params to baseline values for canary route; run A/B with quant error logging. Owner: Jonah. Priority: P1.

3) Stateful QA drift (cluster id: SQ-11)
   - Symptoms: loses slot values across turns when prompts include paraphrases; soft confusion between entities.
   - Sample failing trace included in linked artifacts (see PR comment).
   - Hypothesis: KV-cache shard boundary bug for longseq flavor.
   - Immediate action: rollback KV-cache change for dedicated pools with longseq workload; schedule engineering patch. Owner: Liam. Priority: P0.

4) Safety-guard bypass via adversarial phrasing (cluster id: SG-08)
   - Symptoms: model responds to disallowed requests when user obfuscates intent with uncommon phrasing.
   - Risk: high for enterprise customers with stricter content policies.
   - Action: expand safety promptset with targeted adversarial examples, add unit tests to onboarding pipeline. Owner: Maya. Priority: P1.

5) Numeric reasoning slip for tabular prompts (cluster id: NR-02)
   - Symptoms: off-by-one and aggregation errors when prompt contains small tables; consistent undercount on sums.
   - Short hypothesis: quantization smooths out small integer distinctions in linear layers used for arithmetic.
   - Experiment: run mixed-precision ablation on a sampled promptset; log softmax distributions in numeric layers. Owner: Priya. Priority: P2.

Data notes & caveats:
- Human eval sample size: 300 prompts this window; low coverage for rare prompt polymorphs — prioritize more reps for CB-07 and SG-08.
- Alert thresholds tuned conservatively; some signal noise expected from sampling skew (we saw higher error-rate on region-eu-1 traces due to sequence length distribution).
- Linked artifacts include a failing PR re: kernel selection that landed 2026-07-03; correlation but not proven causation.

Immediate action items (owners + ETA):
- Priya: mark policy-extraction promptset as guarded + add conservative citation postprocess rule. ETA: 2026-07-26.
- Liam: rollback KV-cache shard change on dedicated longseq pools and run smoke suite. ETA: 2026-07-25.
- Jonah: create canary config that pins decoding params and launch A/B (10% traffic) for 72h. ETA: 2026-07-27.
- Maya: expand adversarial safety set by +120 examples and add to nightly regression. ETA: 2026-07-29.
- Priya & Eng-runtime: run mixed-precision numeric ablation test and produce short report. ETA: 2026-08-02.

Planned experiments (short descriptions):
- Decode-param sweep: check stability of nested-instruction tasks across temperature 0.0-0.8 and top_p 0.7-0.95. Metric: nested-instruction adherence score. Owner: Jonah.
- KV-cache guardrail unit: instrument cache eviction heuristics and simulate cross-shard sequences to reproduce SQ-11. Owner: Liam.
- Quant-sensitivity numeric suite: craft 200 targeted table prompts to surface off-by-one behavior. Owner: Priya.

Rolling to customers & rollback policy:
- Canary pause: temporarily stop routing v2.3-longseq for customers flagged in onboarding risklist. Contact CS for any impacted customers.
- Rollback triggers: >2 P0 incidents in 24h or rising safety-failure rate >1.2x baseline for 48h.

Notes to self / open questions (brain dumps):
- Is there an interaction between kernel selection and tokenizer changes that we missed? Need a quick matrix.
- Consider adding a "promptset degeneracy" score to onboarding that quantifies sensitivity under small paraphrases.
- We should automate human-in-the-loop triage for top clusters to reduce manual overhead.

Appendix: quick links & references
- PR with kernel changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482
- Onboarding pipeline run: CON-9012
- Slack discussion: #applied-ml thread (see linked_artifacts)
- Quick local repro steps: see comment on ML-3421

Status summary (refresh cadence):
- This doc will be updated every 2 weeks or on any P0 action.
- Next scheduled refresh: 2026-08-07.

End of brief.
